title: Drag or tap twice? I built a tiny sum-to-ten puzzle with Codex and kept both controls
author: AIWebGame
selftext:
I used Codex to build Ten Crate, a small browser puzzle inspired by the apple game that took off in Korea. You box in numbers that add up to ten. The empty spaces are the fun part: once you clear a few apples, you can reach across the holes for a much longer pick.



The input was trickier than the arithmetic. I wanted to drag a rectangle with a mouse, but on my phone a finger covers the last number. The game also accepts two taps: pick one corner, lift your finger to see the board, then pick the other. Both inputs go through the same rectangle check. The board is seeded by date, so a friend opening the same ticket gets the same apples.



Free to play, with an ad slot after the round: [https://sprout-circuit-daily.pages.dev/ten-crate/](https://sprout-circuit-daily.pages.dev/ten-crate/)
